Docker Cheatsheet

Complete commands and Dockerfile instructions for building, running, debugging, and managing containerized apps.

Docs
Quick Jump:Container LifecycleImages & RegistryInspection & DebuggingPrune & CleanupDocker Compose Commands

Container Lifecycle

Containers
#
docker run -d --name web -p 8080:80 nginx:alpine

Run detached container mapping host 8080 to container 80

docker run -it --rm ubuntu:latest bash

Interactive container that removes itself on exit

docker ps

List currently running containers

docker ps -a

List all containers including stopped ones

docker stop <container>

Gracefully stop running container (SIGTERM)

docker kill <container>

Force kill running container immediately (SIGKILL)

docker restart <container>

Restart container

docker rm -f <container>

Force remove container

Images & Registry

Images
#
docker build -t myapp:1.0 .

Build image from Dockerfile in current directory

docker build --no-cache -t myapp:latest .

Build image without utilizing layer cache

docker images

List local stored images

docker rmi <image_id>

Remove local image

docker pull <image>:<tag>

Fetch image from Docker Hub / registry

docker push <username>/<image>:<tag>

Upload image to remote registry

docker tag <source> <target>

Create tag that refers to source image

Inspection & Debugging

Debug
#
docker logs -f --tail 100 <container>

Stream last 100 lines of live container logs

docker exec -it <container> sh

Open interactive shell inside running container

docker inspect <container_or_image>

Output low-level JSON configuration details

docker stats

Display live stream of container CPU, RAM, I/O usage

docker top <container>

Display running processes inside container

Prune & Cleanup

Maintenance
#
docker container prune -f

Remove all stopped containers

docker image prune -a

Remove all unused images without containers

docker volume prune -f

Remove all unused anonymous and named volumes

docker system prune -a --volumes

Nuclear cleanup: wipe all unused containers, networks, images & volumes

docker system df

Show disk space used by Docker daemon

Docker Compose Commands

Compose
#
CommandDescription
docker compose up -dBuild, (re)create, and start containers in detached mode
docker compose down --volumesStop and remove containers, networks, and persistent volumes
docker compose psList containers running for current compose stack
docker compose logs -f <service>Follow output logs for a specific service
docker compose exec <service> shExecute interactive shell inside service container
docker compose restart <service>Restart specific running service without full teardown
docker compose build --pullRebuild services pulling updated base image layers
